csharpUnityUtilities.template.description: Template for new MonoBehaviour scripts. Use {{NAMESPACE}} and {{CLASSNAME}} as placeholders.

scripts.commit-generated: git add CHANGELOG.md README.md && git commit -m 'docs: auto-update' || echo 'No changes to commit'
scripts.prebuild: bun run changelog && bun run update-readme && bun run commit-generated
scripts.release: bun run prebuild && bun run compile && bun run package && npm version patch && git push origin main --follow-tags && bun x auto-changelog --unreleased-only --stdout --ignore-commit-pattern '^docs: auto-update$' > temp_release_notes.txt && gh release create v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") build/*.vsix --title v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version") --notes-file temp_release_notes.txt && rm temp_release_notes.txt
scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run release
